tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Primary brand color and the Bounty resource fill. Primary GameButton fill, wordmark accent, BountyMeter ring at full charge.

tokens.name: brand-gold-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath brand-gold; darker gold for small text set directly on parchment.

tokens.name: brand-ember
tokens.usage: Secondary brand color and the Player identity accent. Player avatar ring, "you" badges, secondary emphasis.

tokens.name: brand-ember-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath brand-ember; pressed state of player-tinted controls.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Accent brand color and the Opponent identity accent. Opponent avatar ring, "them" badges.

tokens.name: brand-violet-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath brand-violet.

tokens.name: brand-seaglass
tokens.usage: Reward-reveal and focus-ring highlight only — legendary rarity glints, keyboard focus rings, rating-tier promotion. Never a resting UI fill; see the Depth & Lighting doc for exactly where glow is and is not allowed.

tokens.name: player
tokens.usage: Whichever seat the viewer occupies. OfferPlate ownership, chat bubble sent, TurnIndicator glow, avatar ring.

tokens.name: opponent
tokens.usage: The other seat at the table. OfferPlate ownership, chat bubble received, TurnIndicator glow, avatar ring.

tokens.name: bounty
tokens.usage: The bounty multiplier and match stakes. BountyMeter fill, payout numerals, ResultStat “net result” figure when positive.

tokens.name: resource-chip
tokens.usage: Concession chips — the fresh per-match spend resource. ChipMeter fill, chip icon, “chip spent” toast.

tokens.name: resource-chip-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath resource-chip; depleted-chip track tint at reduced opacity.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Deal accepted, favorable surplus capture, rating gains. Never used for the Bounty or chip resources — keep result-of-play green distinct from resource gold/teal.

tokens.name: positive-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath positive; pressed Accept button.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Danger, a low/decaying bounty multiplier, and the Walk Away / destructive action. On surface-world limit to 16px+ or bold text, an icon, or a fill — pair with an icon or label, never color alone (fails small-text contrast on dark; see Accessibility).

tokens.name: crimson-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath crimson; pressed Walk Away / destructive button.

tokens.name: stone-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on parchment surfaces.

tokens.name: stone-400
tokens.usage: Muted icon stroke and secondary borders on parchment surfaces.

tokens.name: stone-700
tokens.usage: Muted/secondary text on parchment surfaces — captions, timestamps, helper copy. 5.3:1 on surface-parchment.

tokens.name: stone-900
tokens.usage: Primary ink on parchment surfaces. 14.8:1 on surface-parchment.

tokens.name: mist-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on dark world/elevated/interactive surfaces.

tokens.name: mist-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons on dark surfaces. Never use for an interactive label — pair with reduced opacity on the whole control instead.

tokens.name: vault-ink
tokens.usage: Confidential/private-information base. ConfidentialCard fill, sealed-dossier and wax-seal motifs.

tokens.name: vault-ink-deep
tokens.usage: Bevel base beneath vault-ink; the confidential card's recessed well.

tokens.name: vault-trim
tokens.usage: Foil trim, wax seal, and stitching details on confidential surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-world, surface-elevated, surface-overlay, surface-interactive. 14.2:1 on surface-world.

tokens.name: ink-muted-on-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the same dark surfaces. 6.6:1 on surface-world.

tokens.name: ink-on-parchment
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-parchment and surface-parchment-deep.

tokens.name: ink-muted-on-parchment
tokens.usage: Secondary text on parchment surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icon color for content placed directly on brand-gold / bounty fills. 6.8:1.

tokens.name: ink-on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icon color for content placed directly on brand-ember fills. 5.9:1.

tokens.name: ink-on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icon color for content placed directly on brand-violet fills. 6.1:1.

tokens.name: ink-on-positive
tokens.usage: Text and icon color for content placed directly on positive fills. 6.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-on-crimson
tokens.usage: Text and icon color for content placed directly on crimson fills. 5.2:1.

tokens.name: ink-on-vault
tokens.usage: Text on vault-ink confidential surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-world
tokens.usage: The base world/background layer behind every screen — the night-market harbor tone. Always paired with warm lantern-glow art direction; never left as flat, undecorated color (see Illustration & Art Direction).

tokens.name: surface-world-deep
tokens.usage: Lower gradient stop of the world background (horizon, water, screen vignette edges).

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Elevated gameplay HUD surface sitting on the world — the resource dock, score rail, top bar.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating overlay surfaces — tooltips, toasts, dropdown menus, the TurnIndicator ribbon.

tokens.name: surface-interactive
tokens.usage: Dark interactive chrome — tab bars, secondary/utility buttons, ChatPanel body.

tokens.name: surface-parchment
tokens.usage: The warm tactile card surface — OfferPlate, ConfidentialCard, result Modal, received ChatBubble, ScenarioHero description plate.

tokens.name: surface-parchment-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed / pressed parchment — OfferPlate inset well, ChipMeter track, input fields drawn on parchment.

tokens.name: surface-modal-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a Modal or BottomSheet, laid over surface-world.

tokens.name: surface-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-disabled-parchment
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill on parchment surfaces.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The Bounty Bay wordmark and splash/hero lockups only.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Asset titles, match-state banners (DEAL COMPLETE, OPPONENT FOUND), ScenarioHero headline.

styles.name: display-subtitle
styles.usage: Section flavor headers, rarity callouts, tavern/board voice copy.

styles.name: numeral-hero
styles.usage: The single largest number on a result screen — the final deal price or surplus % captured. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: numeral-offer
styles.usage: The number inside an OfferPlate — committed, proposed, or incoming price. Tabular numerals required.

styles.name: numeral-stat
styles.usage: Resource and meter numerals — bounty %, chip count, rating figure.

styles.name: numeral-label
styles.usage: Small inline tabular numbers — countdown timers, secondary stat rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, resource-pill captions, section chrome. Apply uppercase sparingly in CSS — never on long strings; see Anti-patterns on excessive letter-spacing.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, fine print under confidential numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip stack overlap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight internal padding — badge and pill insets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between adjacent small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card/plate padding; base grid unit.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between HUD zones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing within a modal or sheet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Safe-area inset on mobile bottom action bars.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the ScenarioHero art and the negotiation HUD.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large layout gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Maximum single gutter; result-screen top clearance.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small tags, timer pill corners, icon-button corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Input fields, small badges, tooltip corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: GameButton corners, resource pill body, chat bubble tail corner.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: OfferPlate, ChatBubble, MatchmakingCard corners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modal, ConfidentialCard, ScenarioHero, RatingBadge shield corners.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: BottomSheet top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, chip capsules, avatar frames, ProgressionBadge ring.

tokens.name: shadow-button-primary
tokens.usage: Resting state of a primary (gold) GameButton — the bottom bevel plus ambient drop.

tokens.name: shadow-button-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed/active state of a primary GameButton — bevel collapses, button sinks 3px.

tokens.name: shadow-button-positive
tokens.usage: Resting state of a positive-contextual (Accept) GameButton.

tokens.name: shadow-button-positive-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a positive-contextual GameButton.

tokens.name: shadow-button-destructive
tokens.usage: Resting state of the destructive (Walk Away) GameButton.

tokens.name: shadow-button-destructive-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of the destructive GameButton.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary
tokens.usage: Resting state of a secondary (dark) GameButton on surface-world.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a secondary GameButton.

tokens.name: shadow-card-elevated
tokens.usage: Dark elevated gameplay panels — ambient drop plus a 1px top rim highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-card-parchment
tokens.usage: Parchment cards and plates — warm ambient drop plus a paper-edge top highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-card-parchment-recessed
tokens.usage: The inset well inside an OfferPlate or ChipMeter track.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and BottomSheet elevation above the scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip and Toast elevation above gameplay surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-reward
tokens.usage: Reward-reveal glow only — legendary asset reveal, rating-tier promotion, deal-accepted burst. Prohibited on resting buttons, cards, or icons; see Depth & Lighting.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring. Meets 3:1 against surface-world and surface-parchment alike.
